description: Async proto-learning capture. SubagentStop analyses each finished build subagent's transcript; SessionEnd analyses the orchestration session once at the end for loop-level lessons. Both run OFF the critical path — the hook is async and the analyzer is spawned detached, with the invoking session inbound-message bindings stripped so it can never receive an event meant for the loop — act only on ops loop runs, and file a proto-learning issue when something worth improving happened. Capture is uniform framework machinery rather than a per-repo capability, so lessons compound across every repo the engine works.
